brand.name: EDS PIXEL di Emilio De Leo
brand.type: SaaS Hub Gestionale per Laboratorio di Riparazioni Elettroniche
brand.theme_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & ELECTRIC NEON (Quantum Tech Dark)

responsive.layout: Mobile-first single-column reflow for dashboards and POS, stacking cards smoothly into grid-cols-1 on small screens, grid-cols-2 on tablet, grid-cols-4 on desktop. Touch POS grid scales down from 5 items row to responsive flex-wrap touch tiles with minimum 48px tap targets.
responsive.typography: Fluid rem-based scaling. Desktop headings text-3xl to text-5xl max, mobile headings text-xl to text-2xl. Subtitles text-sm to text-base. Inputs and dropdowns set to text-base (16px equivalent) to avoid iOS automatic canvas zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root viewport containers. Tables wrap in scrollable x-containers. Grid children set to min-w-0 to prevent flex/grid blowouts.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum touch target height 48px for Cassa Touch POS, status quick action buttons, WhatsApp actions, and navigation triggers.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-700/60 shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-950/20
visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 p-5 shadow-lg hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.kpi_glow_box: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-cyan-500/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-900 to-cyan-950/40 p-6 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-900/20
visual_enhancers.print_sheet_a4: A4 vertical split sheet: exact 210mm width printable layout divided 50/50 vertically into 'COPIA CLIENTE' (Left) and 'COPIA LABORATORIO' (Right) with barcoding/QR, tear lines, legal terms, signature lines.
visual_enhancers.thermal_label: Isolated 58mm/80mm label thermal print layout with crisp high-contrast QR code, ticket ID (e.g., EDS-8942), client name, device details, intake date.

grids_and_layouts.executive_dashboard: Grid layout: top metric KPI bar (Tickets in registro, in lavorazione, pronti al ritiro, consegnati), heavy hero box for 'Denaro Fermo in Laboratorio' (€ value of uncollected repaired devices), 'Piano Riscatto Spese Fisse' target daily gauge (€175-190/giorno), interactive chart, and recent activity feed.
grids_and_layouts.ticket_registry: Dense filterable table & card grid with quick action bar: WhatsApp direct wa.me link with pre-filled status text, status advancement modal/popup, A4 receipt print preview, thermal label print trigger, edit ticket drawer, delete confirmation.
grids_and_layouts.touch_pos_cassa: Split layout: Left column = Touch quick item grid (Pellicola Idrogel, EPU HD, Cuffie, Cavi Type-C, Adapter) + search bar; Right column = Active Cart, client link, discount/tax controls, checkout tender button (Contanti, POS, Transfer).
grids_and_layouts.public_tracking_portal: Clean, high-trust single-page tracking view accessible via ?track=CODE or /track/:code showing live repair progress timeline, estimate total, technician notes, and WhatsApp support button.

motion.micro_interactions: Framer Motion layout transitions on state updates, smooth drawer slide-ins, status badge pulsing animation for 'in lavorazione', instant tactile tap effects on POS grid buttons.
motion.hover_effects: Hover lift with subtle cyan drop-shadow (-translate-y-0.5), button focus rings ring-2 ring-cyan-400/50.

component_rules.use_javascript: All components are JavaScript React files (.js / .jsx).
component_rules.shadcn_customization: Heavily styled for Dark Quantum theme. Select, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, DropdownMenu must have non-transparent solid slate-900 background with border-slate-700.
component_rules.sonner_toasts: Sonner toasts styled with slate-900 background, cyan accent borders, and explicit high contrast white text.
component_rules.date_and_time: Use Italian date formatting (e.g., 24 Luglio 2026, 14:30) and EUR currency (€ 120,00).

instructions_to_main_agent.1_core_architecture: Build a full-featured, responsive Italian management hub for 'EDS PIXEL di Emilio De Leo'. Maintain Dark Quantum theme strictly (#0b132b / #0f172a) with high-visibility electric cyan & neon green highlights.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_data_and_mocking: Provide comprehensive local state / API persistence for repairs, customers, POS transactions, fixed expenses, daily report, shop settings, and multi-role auth (Admin/Tecnico with default admin@edspixel.it / admin123).
3_key_features: Multi-role Auth (Admin vs Tecnico access level)
Executive Dashboard 'Multiquantum' with KPI metrics, 'Denaro Fermo in Laboratorio' box, and 'Piano Riscatto Spese Fisse' (Target 175-190€/giorno target progress)

Ticket Registry with Quick Action Bar: WhatsApp wa.me trigger with automated message templates, status change modal, isolated A4 printable sheet (vertical split: Copia Cliente + Copia Laboratorio), Thermal Label print view with QR code
New Ticket Creation Wizard with device condition checklist, estimated price, deposit, pattern lock/PIN input
Touch POS Cassa with favorite accessories grid (Pellicola Idrogel, EPU HD, Cuffie, Cavi Type-C, Adapter), cart calculator, and instant thermal receipt trigger
Public Live Tracking Portal (?track=CODE) with progress steppers and live status check
Multi-tenant Shop Settings (Business info, A4 printer header, logo, fixed expenses manager)
Daily Accounting & Growth Tips section ('Consigli Business') providing actionable insights to optimize workshop profitability
instructions_to_main_agent.4_print_views: Ensure print styles (@media print) hide navigation and isolate the printable container clean and crisp on white background with 100% legibility.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_data_testid_requirement: EVERY button, input, navigation tab, modal trigger, print button, and quick action icon MUST include a unique kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='kpi-denaro-fermo', data-testid='ticket-whatsapp-button-EDS-101', data-testid='pos-item-idrogel').
